location: US-WS, T-109; ex Moravian community of Salem.
dimensions: mp rcvr 11.5, slide exit 9, bo1 9.8, bo2 9****, slide sec. 1227.5, bell-sec. entry 12, be 111.5¹, le 2278.5.
remarks: Slide sec. from an alto trombone; initial 676.5mm of of bell sec. probably part of the same alto trombone; terminal 420mm of bell sec. (with knob or ball) from a trumpet. Tubular slide-stays. Descending outer slide tube at proximal end has “X”: a matching “X” appears on the ferrule adjacent to the immoveable slide-stay; its purpose apparently is to show proper position of outer slide. Ferrules have simple ring pattern. Slide- bow does not make a perfect arc, but is somewhat sqaured. Ring in slide-bow is narrow strip of brass sheet; saddle for ring has zig-zag pattern around periphery and in center. Dents in slide-bow, neck-pipe, bell-bow, bell-pipe. Slide very stiff, but moveable. No slide stockings. Flat bell-stay, in scalloped pattern, with zig-zag ornaments around periphery and in center. Solder repair on neck-pipe above first ferrule. (Trumpet) bell has two simple rings. Quite possibly the alto trombone portion of this instrument was part of an order placed ca. 1783 for the Moravian communities of Salem and nearby Bethabara.  Negotiated by Gottfried Weber in Herrnhut, the Moravian center in German, the included: for Bethabara, a set of trombones with silver-plated mouthpieces, one pair of D# (=E-flat) horns with crooks, mouthpieces, and three pairs of mouthpiece bits, one pair of trumpets with six mouthpiece bits and two mouthpieces together with wrappings; and for Salem, another set of trombones with silver-plated mouthpieces, one pair of D# horns with crooks, two mouthpieces, and six mouthpiece bits, some trombone sonatas, two horn books, and four chorale books for trombones.²  Remnants of this order perhaps still exist in the form of a horn and the bell section of a trumpet (B-227) by Johann Joseph Schmied, both dated 1784, in the Boys’ School Museum in Old Salem³, and another Schmied horn with the same date in the Moravian Music Foundation.⁴
